purpose: Close data-quality and reference-access prerequisites; evaluate only semantically compatible tasks

kedarnath_scene_selection.same_sensor_path_row_tier: Landsat8 path145 row039 Tier1; full case footprint coverage required
kedarnath_scene_selection.ranking: Descending common QA-clear fraction with fixed May22 baseline, then ascending observation time, then itemID
kedarnath_scene_selection.selection_inputs: Only scene metadata, QA_PIXEL, QA_RADSAT and source validity; no reflectance change predictions or reference grades
kedarnath_scene_selection.post_selection: Acquire reflectance only for the single best eligible scene; no threshold retuning or second-best substitution after registration/analysis
kedarnath_scene_selection.temporal_interpretation: Later postevent scene is seasonal/recovery context; not peak June16–17 extent or causal disaster attribution

registration.additional_acceptance: Held-out PRE-correction p95 displacement<=1.5px for uncorrected relative alignment; post-fit residual is not proof of existing alignment
registration.correction: No source correction or automatic physical/absolute/SAR-optical pass
registration.controls: Actual image self-pair, deterministic+4x−3yshift, unrelated random image; controls remain software tests not ground control

delhi_drainage.layers: Sangam service all0–7; Aug2024stormdrains all0–20; portal WaterLogging_50m and DEM metadata
delhi_drainage.roles: Native mapped drainage/utility/colony geometry and positive-only waterlogging context; not event exposure labels
delhi_drainage.epochs: Service-name vintage is not surveyed observation time; unknown dates remain unknown; no2017/2023drain state inferred
delhi_drainage.coverage: All featureIDs intersecting the fixed envelope; no manual convenient subset; bounded25000features or unavailable
delhi_drainage.metrics: Unique clipped mapped drain length;2017/2023built-class gains near mapped drains at30/90/150m; model-stream-to-reference distance and sensitivity at30/90m
delhi_drainage.terrain_reference: Official drains include engineered channels; disagreement is expected for bare D8DSM and does not measure exposure accuracy
delhi_drainage.unknown: Not mapped is not absence; no waterlogging negatives; no drain blockage/capacity/flow direction inferred
delhi_drainage.license: No explicit native redistribution license established; raw geometry remains private local research

holdout_policy.EMSR927: All existing AOIs previously inspected development
holdout_policy.Sen1Floods11: Already trained/evaluated in SATQuery; not a new untouched test
holdout_policy.new_external: Must identify unseen event/geography and freeze IDs before reading annotation pixel values; standard benchmark use is not case-specific exposure truth
holdout_policy.case_accuracy: Do not calculate exposureprecision/recall or IoU without compatible positive and negative reference support
